rows.label: tlk70000074_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Even the records of the Holleshorn
family contain no account of Iira ever
undergoing a change like this...

rows.label: tlk70000074_05_msg0002
rows.name:
As head of the Holleshorn family, I'll
record this in detail and pass it down
through the generations.

rows.label: tlk70000074_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I believe those of us living here
in Superbia have a duty to future
generations to carry this out.

rows.label: tlk70000074_05_msg0004
rows.name:
So, Your Majesty, everyone: leave the
rest to us, and devote yourselves
fully to your mission.
